title: Healthy Active Living Education
description: This course equips students with the knowledge and skills they need to make healthy choices now and lead healthy active lives in the future. Students participate in a wide range of physical activities and develop an understanding of personal fitness healthy living and relationship skills.

title: Healthy Active Living Education
description: Students develop knowledge and skills related to physical activity personal fitness safety healthy eating mental health substance use human development and healthy relationships. They participate in varied activities and create plans that support lifelong healthy active living.

title: Healthy Active Living Education
description: Students develop and apply personal fitness movement and healthy living skills through participation in a variety of physical activities. They investigate factors affecting personal health and build strategies for maintaining lifelong well-being.

title: Healthy Active Living Education
description: Students further develop the knowledge and skills needed to lead healthy active lives. The course emphasizes personal fitness participation leadership decision-making and the development of plans that support long-term physical and emotional well-being.

title: Health for Life
description: Students examine factors that influence personal health and well-being and develop strategies for making informed health decisions. Topics include nutrition physical activity mental health relationships substance use personal safety and community health.

title: Recreation and Healthy Active Living Leadership
prerequisite: Any Health and Physical Education course
description: Students develop leadership and coordination skills related to recreation fitness and healthy active living. They plan organize and lead activities while examining leadership styles group dynamics safety community recreation and related careers.

title: Introductory Kinesiology
prerequisite: Any Grade 11 university or university/college preparation course in Science or any Grade 11 or Grade 12 course in Health and Physical Education
description: Students study human movement and physical activity through the sciences of anatomy physiology biomechanics motor learning and sport psychology. They examine the social and cultural dimensions of physical activity and explore related postsecondary and career pathways.
